items.claim: Block group with a `block-N` id written anonymous, so links and styles naming it were lost

items.note: The reader now takes the name from front matter or a directive. The writer now writes a main branch not named `main` as that setting. Before, it renamed the branch to `main` with a warning, and threw when the graph also had another branch called `main`.

items.claim: Front matter `config:` dropped with no warning
Empty front matter `---\n---` not skipped by the readers
Flowchart ignored `accTitle` and dropped `accTitle`/`accDescr` as unknown statements
Architecture writer turned a non-compass port into R/L with no warning
items.note: The block, class, ER and C4 writers also dropped ports with no warning; the same commit fixes those (sweep), through one `dropPorts` helper that the flowchart now uses too.

items.claim: Class `note` text read from `lines` only, so text held in `rows` was written empty
Gantt wrote `after <id>` for an id it had just dropped
items.note: Ids are dropped first, repeating until none is left to drop, using plot's public `setGanttTaskId`. A task that started after a dropped id now follows the task before it; one that ended at a dropped id lasts a day. Both come with a warning.

items.claim: `metaEnd` read an apostrophe inside a plain metadata value as an opening quote
C4 `<<person_db>>`/`<<person_queue>>` written as a macro the reader refuses
items.note: The writer now writes such an element as a plain person, with a warning. `kindOfStereotype` now goes through `kindOfMacro`, so the two cannot disagree about which kinds exist.

items.claim: C4 front matter title replaced by a `title` statement with no warning
items.note: It also warns when an `accTitle` is replaced the same way (sweep).
